timer: time.perf_counter; external elapsed wall-clock seconds around each search call
timing_includes: Search, algorithm input-validity guard, board copies made inside algorithm, move generation, terminal detection, evaluation
timing_excludes: Imports, fixture construction and pre-search fixture validation, output formatting, CSV/JSON writes, warm-up
warmup: One unrecorded MinMax depth-1 call and one unrecorded MCTS 2-iteration call on first position
schedule: All conditions and repetitions shuffled with independent schedule_seed
summary_policy: Median/min/max among completed searches only; incomplete rows retained and counted

node_count_semantics.minimax: Root plus all entered recursive nodes
node_count_semantics.mcts: Allocated tree nodes including root; excludes rollout positions

seed_policy: MCTS repetition r uses seed r-1; timing spread includes random rollout-path variation
rollout_plies_semantics: Sum of rollout plies in completed MCTS simulations only

positions.label: Four-piece rook ending
positions.rationale: Very low material with long-range rook moves; sparse need not mean immobile.

positions.label: Seven-piece rook ending
positions.rationale: Adds asymmetric pawn material to two kings and two rooks.

positions.label: Eleven-piece rook ending
positions.rationale: Larger pawn population changes mobility and captures without adding minor pieces.

positions.label: Sixteen-piece pawn blockade
positions.rationale: Paired material count with mixed_16; blocked pawn advances but captures remain legal.

positions.label: Sixteen-piece mixed position
positions.rationale: Same piece count as pawns_16, with queens, rooks and minor pieces increasing mobility.

positions.label: Reduced middlegame
positions.rationale: Developed pieces and castled kings with some central material removed.

positions.label: Initial position
positions.rationale: Full material with initially restricted mobility; paired with italian_32.

positions.label: Italian development
positions.rationale: Full material after development; isolates mobility changes without captures.
positions.provenance: Legal sequence: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5
